title: Sphinx Wizard and Skeletons
description: A hairless sphinx-like creature with a unicorn horn, glasses, and multiple eyes sits on a wooden pedestal, writing with a pencil in an open book with dripping colorful liquid. Through a stone archway behind it is a surreal landscape with a glowing sunset over a winding river with boats. In the foreground, three skeletons in robes stand on a glowing magical circle surrounded by papers and a small skull, while an open cabinet to the right displays skulls and colorful potion bottles.
